fields.description: Program Description Educational Objectives The program for Industrial Engineering aims at training students to become experts in operational management and system analysis, who will be able to plan, design, evaluate, and optimize the production system with creative and critical thinking in the areas of manufacturing, business, and service. Students majoring in Industrial Engineering are required to master basic theories of industrial engineering, receive trainings on basic knowledge and methods of industrial engineering, and acquire basic abilities for development and design of practical management system. The graduates are required to master the knowledge or abilities as follows: 1. Basic theories and knowledge of industrial engineering; 2. Analytical methods and technology of systematic management; 3. Knowledge of mechanical engineering and Strong ability of computer and foreign language application; 4. Methods, specifications and standards which are related to economic construction and enterprise management； 5. The leading edge and development trend of modern industrial engineering; 6. Basic methods of literature retrieval and information inquiry, as well as the abilities of scientific research and practical working. fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certificate of non-criminal record 2. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 3. Bank statement of the applicant or financial sponsor 4. Description of school performance(for applicants who have learning experiences in China) * 5. Valid physical examination report * 6. Front pages of passport and visa page issued by Chinese embassies(if there are any) With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 7. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 8. Senior high school Certificate/diploma or A Level Certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 9. Senior high school academic transcript or A level transcripts Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be healthy and well-behaved, and have a foreign citizenship.According to the NO.12 (2020) Announcement of the Ministry of Education of People's Republic of China, applicants who have foreign nationality at birth but both or one of their parents are Chinese citizens who settled in a foreign country, as well as residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan who have obtained foreign nationality after immigrating should hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the most recent 4 years (by April 30 of the enrollment year) (The actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to entry and exit signatures). 2. Applicants should have good academic records and an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma. 3. Applicants should be between the ages of 18 and 25. For the applicants under 18 by Sep. 1st 2025 , a Guardian Statement is required. 4. Language Requirements English language proficiency certificate is required for programs taught in English and applicants who are not nativeEnglish speakers, which include score report of English Proficiency test likeTOEFL 80+/ IELTS 6.0+/ TOEFL My Best/ TOEFL iBT Home Edition/ TOEFL Essentials, and etc. For applicants who cannot offer the above-mentioned standardized English test results, they will be required to participate in an additional oral or written English test organized by Wuhan University of Technology.
